title: Secondary Metabolites Accumulation in Ethnic Turmeric Planted in Northern Mountain of Vietnam
content: The traditional turmeric grown in the Northern Mountains of Vietnam could be a valuable source of natural compounds, especially of curcuminoid with potential applications in functional foods and biotherapeutic products. Leveraging the cultural significance and unique phytochemical attributes of this traditional turmeric could help promote the sustainable development and preservation of the ethnic minority communities' agricultural heritage in the Northern Mountain region of Vietnam.
